blocks.en:
◈ Registration for Graduate Research Students: Spring 2026 ◈

1. Registration Period

A. 1st Round: Feb. 20 (Fri) 09:00 – Mar. 9 (Mon) 17:00, 2026 (11 days)

※ Note: Students completing coursework in Feb. 2026 can make payments starting Mar. 3 (Tue).

B. 2nd Round: Mar. 19 (Thu) 09:00 – Mar. 31 (Tue) 17:00, 2026 (9 days)

*Payment is available 24 hours a day on weekdays (closes at 17:00 on the final day).

2. Eligibility

Students who have completed their graduate coursework and wish to use university facilities (libraries, laboratories, computer labs, SNU dormitories, etc.) or submit a thesis/dissertation this semester.

3. Amount of Payment

A. Humanities․Social Science․Arts․Physical Education: KRW 150,000

B. Natural Science․Engineering: KRW 200,000

4. Location of Payment

Any branch of NH Bank (Nonghyup) or Shinhan Bank.

5. Method of Payment

A. Pay at a designated bank using the printed bill.

B. Transfer to the individual virtual account indicated on the bill.

6. How to Print the Bill of Payment

Log in to the MySNU portal (http://my.snu.ac.kr/mysnu) ⇒ Academic Affairs (학사/정보) ⇒ Tuition (등록) ⇒ Billing Info (고지서/내역조회) ⇒ Bill of Research Student’s Share (연구생부담금고지서), and print the bill <Printing is available from Feb. 20, 2026 (Fri)>

※ If you cannot print from the portal, contact your department office or the administrative office of your college.

7. Precautions

A. Registration is mandatory to use university facilities and apply for thesis examination.

B. Thesis examination cannot be requested without research student registration.

C. Students participating in the BK21 program, or those serving as a Principal Investigator (PI) or participating researcher for a research project after completing their coursework, must be registered as research students.

D. Those planning to work as Teaching Assistants or Work-Study Students for Spring 2026 must register during the 1st Round.

E. Refund requests can be made via mySNU (http://my.snu.ac.kr/mysnu) and go to Academic Affairs(학사/정보) ⇒ Tuition(등록) ⇒ Installment Payment/Refund(분납/환불신청) and fill in Research Student Refund Application(연구생부담금환불신청) during the 2nd Round registration period.

F. For more details, please contact the administrative office of your college/graduate school.

blocks.en: 가. Students

blocks.en: Log in (with your student ID) to the SNU student portal 마이스누 (mySNU) (http://my.snu.ac.kr), then select 학사/정보 (Academic Affairs/Information) ⇒ 등록 (Registration) ⇒ 고지서/내역조회 (Bill/Payment History) ⇒ 연구생부담금고지서 (Research Student Fee Bill) and print it. <Printing is available from 20 Feb 2026 (Fri).>

blocks.en: ※ If you cannot print it from the 마이스누 (mySNU) portal, contact the administrative office of your department and college (or graduate school).
blocks.ko: ※ 포털 마이스누에서 출력이 되지 않는 경우 소속 학과 및 대학(원) 교무행정실로 문의

blocks.en: 나. College (graduate school) staff
blocks.ko: 나. 대학(원) 담당자

blocks.en: 통합행정정보시스템 (Integrated Administrative Information System) ⇒ 학적관리 (Student Records Management) ⇒ 연구생등록관리 (Research Student Registration Management) ⇒ 연구생등록금고지서 출력 (Print Research Student Fee Bill) ⇒ enter student ID number ⇒ 미리보기 (Preview) (after checking) ⇒ print
blocks.ko: 통합행정정보시스템 ⇒ 학적관리 ⇒ 연구생등록관리 ⇒ 연구생등록금고지서 출력 ⇒ 학번입력 ⇒ 미리보기(확인 후) ⇒ 프린터 출력

blocks.en: ※ For students approved for an extension of the thesis submission deadline (2 years) and students approved as research students who have exceeded the regular number of semesters (규정학기 초과자), enter the additional information before printing.
blocks.ko: ※ 논문제출기한 연장(2년) 승인자 및 규정학기 초과자 연구생으로 승인받은 자는 추가 입력 후 출력

blocks.en: ※ Students who registered for courses as research students exceeding the regular number of semesters (초과자연구생) do not need to pay the research student fee. (However, they must pay tuition per credit.)

blocks.en: 8. Important Notes
blocks.ko: 8. 유의사항

blocks.en: 가. You must register as a research student in order to use university facilities and to apply for thesis review (논문심사, thesis examination).
blocks.ko: 가. 학교시설 이용 및 논문심사를 신청하기 위해서는 반드시 연구생 등록을 하여야 함.

blocks.en: 나. If you do not register as a research student, you cannot apply for thesis review.
blocks.ko: 나. 연구생등록을 하지 않을 경우 논문심사 신청 불가

blocks.en: 다. If, after completing your coursework, you take part in the BK21 program, or you are a principal investigator or participating researcher on a research project, you must register as a graduate research student.
blocks.ko: 다. 수료 후 BK21 사업에 참여하는 경우 또는 연구과제의 책임자 및 참여연구원의 경우 대학원 연구생 등록하여야 함.

blocks.en: 라. If, after completing your coursework, you will work as a 강의연구지원장학생 (teaching/research assistant scholarship student) or 근로장학생 (work-study scholarship student) in the 1st semester of the 2026 academic year, you must register during the 1st registration period.
blocks.ko: 라. 수료 후 2026학년도 1학기 강의연구지원장학생 또는 근로장학생으로 근무할 자는 필히 1차 등록기간에 등록하여야 함.

blocks.en: 마. Students who, after paying, want a refund for an unavoidable reason must apply for the refund during the 2nd registration period by filling in the 연구생부담금환불신청서 (Research Student Fee Refund Application) on the 마이스누 (mySNU) portal (http://my.snu.ac.kr/mysnu) under 학사/정보 (Academic Affairs/Information) ⇒ 등록 (Registration) ⇒ 분납/환불신청 (Installment/Refund Application).
blocks.ko: 마. 납부 후 부득이한 사유로 환불을 원하는 학생은 2차 등록기간 중 포털 마이스누(http://my.snu.ac.kr/mysnu)에서 학사/정보 ⇒ 등록 ⇒ 분납/환불신청 ⇒ 연구생부담금환불신청서를 작성하여 환불 신청

blocks.en: 바. For other details, contact the administrative office of your college (or graduate school).
blocks.ko: 바. 기타 자세한 사항은 소속 대학(원) 교무행정실로 문의

blocks.en: Seoul National University Regulations on Graduate Research Students (대학원 연구생 규정)
blocks.ko: 서울대학교 대학원 연구생 규정

blocks.en: Seoul National University Regulations on Graduate Research Students [Effective 30 Jul 2020] [Seoul National University Regulation No. 2244, 30 Jul 2020, Partially Amended]
blocks.ko: 서울대학교 대학원 연구생 규정 [시행 2020.7.30] [서울대학교학교규정 제2244호, 2020.7.30, 일부개정]

blocks.en: Academic Affairs Division (교무과)
blocks.ko: 교무과

blocks.en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these regulations is to set out the necessary matters concerning graduate research students (대학원 연구생) of Seoul National University under Article 98 of the 「Seoul National University Academic Rules」 (서울대학교 학칙; hereinafter the “「Academic Rules」”). [Amended 7 Jun 2002, 12 Jul 2012, 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규정은 「서울대학교 학칙」(이하 “「학칙」”이라 한다) 제98조에 따른 서울대학교 대학원 연구생에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. [개정 2002. 6. 7., 2012. 7. 12., 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.en: Article 2 (Definition of Terms) A graduate research student is a person who has completed the coursework of a graduate degree program (수료, completion of coursework), has finished the required registration, and is preparing a degree thesis. [Amended 7 Jun 2002, 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 제2조(용어의 정의) 대학원 연구생은 대학원 학위과정을 수료한 후 소정의 등록을 마치고 학위논문을 준비하는 사람을 말한다. [개정 2002. 6. 7., 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.en: Article 3 (Taking Courses) ① A graduate research student may take courses that replace the thesis qualifying exam (논문제출자격시험) with the recommendation of the thesis advisor and the approval of the head of the department (or school) or the head of the major program (전공주임). [Amended 30 Jul 2020] ② When registering as a graduate research student under Article 11, Paragraph 5 of the 「Seoul National University Regulations on Conferment of Degrees」 (서울대학교 학위수여 규정; hereinafter the “「Degree Conferment Regulations」”), a student must earn at least 6 credits for a master's program or at least 9 credits for a doctoral program; for a doctoral program, the student must take courses for at least 2 semesters. [Amended 30 Jul 2020] ③ Credits earned under Paragraphs 1 and 2 are not counted toward the credits required for completion of coursework, but they are recorded in the academic record (학적부). [Amended 30 Jul 2020] [Title amended 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 제3조(교과목 수강) ① 대학원 연구생은 논문지도교수의 추천과 소속 학과(부)장 또는 전공주임의 승인을 받아 논문제출자격시 험 대체교과목을 수강할 수 있다. [개정 2020. 7. 30.] ② 「서울대학교 학위수여 규정」(이하 “「학위수여 규정」”이라 한다) 제11조제5항에 따라 대학원 연구생으로 등록하는 경우 석사과정은 6학점 이상, 박사과정은 9학점 이상 취득하되, 박사과정의 경우 2개 학기 이상 교과목을 수강하여야 한다. [개 정 2020. 7. 30.] ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 이수한 학점은 수료학점에는 포함하지 않으나 학적부에 등재한다. [개정 2020. 7. 30.] [제목개정 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.en: Article 4 (Status) ① A graduate research student is registered in the department (or school) and major in which the student was enrolled. However, if that department (or school) or major has been abolished, the dean of the original college (or graduate school) may, with the approval of the President, have the graduate research student register in a department (or school) or major that runs a curriculum similar to that of the original department (or school) or major, for the purpose of research activities and thesis supervision until the student graduates. [Newly established 30 Jul 2020] ② A graduate research student may use university facilities and, upon request, may be issued a certificate confirming status as a graduate research student. [Amended 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 제4조(신분) ① 대학원 연구생은 재학 당시의 학과(부)·전공에 등록한다. 다만, 해당 학과(부)·전공이 폐지된 경우에는 해당 대학원 연구생의 졸업 시까지의 연구활동 및 논문지도를 위하여 원 소속 대학(원)장이 총장의 승인을 얻어 원 소속 학과(부 )·전공과 유사한 교과과정을 운영하는 학과(부)·전공에 등록하도록 할 수 있다. [신설 2020. 7. 30.] ② 대학원 연구생은 학교시설물을 이용할 수 있으며, 본인의 신청에 따라 대학원 연구생임을 확인할 수 있는 증명서를 발급 받을 수 있다. [개정 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.en: Article 5 (Registration and Registration Deadline) ① A person who falls under any of the following items must register as a graduate research student during the designated period every semester.
blocks.ko: 제5조(등록 및 등록기한) ① 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람은 매 학기 지정된 기간에 대학원 연구생 등록을 하여야 한

blocks.en: [Amended 30 Jul 2020]
1. When the person wishes to undergo the degree thesis review
blocks.ko: 1. 학위논문심사를 받고자 하는 경우

blocks.en: 2. When the dean of each college (or graduate school) has made registration as a research student mandatory for using university facilities such as laboratories, practice rooms and graduate research buildings
blocks.ko: 2. 실험 실습실, 대학원 연구동 등의 학교 시설물을 이용하고자 할 때 각 대학(원)장이 연구생 등록을 의무적으로 하도록 정 한 경우

blocks.en: 3. When the person wishes to use university facilities in general, such as the Central Library, Gwanak Residence Halls (관악학생생활관) and the Information Technology Services (정보화본부) ② The registration deadline for graduate research students is the thesis submission deadline for each degree program set out in Article 11 of the 「Degree Conferment Regulations」. [Newly established 30 Jul 2020] [Title amended 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 3. 중앙도서관, 관악학생생활관, 정보화본부 등 학교 제반 시설을 이용하고자 하는 경우 ② 대학원 연구생의 등록기한은「학위수여 규정」 제11조의 각 학위과정별 논문 제출기한으로 한다. [신설 2020. 7. 30.] [제목개정 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.en: Article 6 (Loss of Status) A person who has acted against the duties of a graduate research student may lose that status after review by the Graduate Academic Affairs Committee (대학원 학사위원회) of the college (or graduate school) to which the person belongs. [Amended 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 제6조(자격상실) 대학원 연구생의 본분에 어긋난 행위를 한 사람에 대하여 소속 대학(원)의 대학원 학사위원회 심의를 거쳐 그 자격을 상실하도록 할 수 있다. [개정 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.en: Article 7 (Collection of Research Student Fees) ① Fees such as charges for the use of university facilities are collected from graduate research students, and the amount charged per student is as shown in the attached table (별표).
blocks.ko: 제7조(연구생 부담금 징수) ① 대학원 연구생에게는 학교시설 사용료 등 부담금을 징수하며, 학생 1명당 징수금액은 별표와 같

blocks.en: [Amended 30 Jul 2020] ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, when a student takes courses under Article 3, Paragraphs 1 and 2, the research student fee is collected according to the tuition standards for students registered beyond the standard period of study (수업연한 초과 등록자). [Amended 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 다. [개정 2020. 7. 30.] ② 제1항에도 불구하고 제3조제1항 및 제2항에 따라 교과목을 수강하는 경우에는 수업연한 초과 등록자의 등록금 책정기준 에 따라 연구생 부담금을 징수한다. [개정 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.ko: 법제처 1 국가법령정보센터 서울대학교 대학원 연구생 규정

blocks.en: [Title amended 30 Jul 2020]

Article 8 (Details) Details not specified in these regulations are determined separately by the President after review by the Graduate School Council (대학원위원회). [Amended 30 Jul 2020] [Title amended 30 Jul 2020]
blocks.ko: 제8조(세부사항) 이 규정에 명시되지 않은 세부사항은 대학원위원회의 심의를 거쳐 총장이 따로 정한다. [개정 2020. 7. 30.] [제목개정 2020. 7. 30.]

blocks.en: Addendum (부칙) <No. 2244, 30 Jul 2020>
These regulations take effect on the date of promulgation.
blocks.ko: 이 규정은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.

english: ※ If you do not register within the registration period, late registration is not possible.
1. Who should register

Among graduate students who have completed their coursework (수료생, students who have finished all required credits but have not yet received a degree), only those who fall under 가, 나 or 다 below should register.
★ This does not apply to currently enrolled students!! Students expected to complete their coursework in February 2026 who fall under 가, 나 or 다 must register!

가. Those who have completed a graduate program and wish to use university facilities (library, laboratories and practice rooms, graduate research rooms, 관악학생생활관 (Gwanak Residence Halls), etc.) or to submit a degree thesis in the 1st semester of the 2026 academic year
※ If you do not register as a research student (연구생), you cannot apply for thesis examination (the doctoral preliminary examination is still possible)

나. Those who will work as a Teaching and Research Support Scholarship student (강의연구지원장학생) or a Work-Study Scholarship student (근로장학생) in the 1st semester of the 2026 academic year after completing their coursework must register during the 1st registration period

다. Those who participate in the BK Plus program after completing their coursework, or who are the principal investigator or a participating researcher of a research project: research student registration is required
2. Registration period
가. 1st period: 20 Feb 2026 (Fri) 09:00 ~ 9 Mar 2026 (Mon) 17:00 ★Check the dates!!
※ Students who complete their coursework in February 2026 can pay from 3 Mar 2026 (Tue)
※ Payment is possible 24 hours a day on weekdays (closes at 17:00 on the last day)
나. 2nd period: 19 Mar 2026 (Thu) 09:00 ~ 31 Mar 2026 (Tue) 17:00 (final) ★Check the dates!!
※ Payment is possible 24 hours a day on weekdays (closes at 17:00 on the last day)
3. Amount to pay: KRW 200,000 (200,000원, 이십만원)
4. Where and how to pay (※ No separate application is needed besides the payment)
가. Where: any branch of NH NongHyup Bank (농협은행) or Shinhan Bank (신한은행)
나. How:
Method 1) Pay at a designated bank with the printed payment notice (납부고지서)
Method 2) Pay by bank transfer to your personal virtual account shown on the payment notice
5. How to print the payment notice
Log in to 마이스누 (mySNU, mysnu.ac.kr) → 학사/정보 (Academic Information) → 등록 (Registration) → 고지서/내역조회 (Notice/History Inquiry) → select ‘연구생부담금고지서’ (Research Student Fee Notice) and print it
6. Issuing a payment confirmation
Log in to 마이스누 (mySNU, mysnu.ac.kr) → 학사/정보 (Academic Information) → 증명/확인서 (Certificates/Confirmations) → 증명/확인서 발급 (Issue Certificates/Confirmations)
7. For refund applications and other details, please refer to the attached file
